00.name: Narrator
00.text: As you get to the end of the forest a lone tree stands in the middle of thr trail blocking your path.

01_1.name: Sweat
01_1.text: Oh great. Another tree. Mortal you know what to do.

03.name: Sweat
03.text: Of course. Why are you confused we're in a forest, were else are you going to find a tree.

04.name: Sour
04.text: Why is the tree blocking the path.

05.text: That is because I am no ordinary tree.

06.name: Lumberjack
06.text: Did... did that tree just talk.

08.name: Choc'lat
08.text: My name is Choc'lat. I am the gaurdian spirit of this forest. When the forest is in danger I branch out an arm to save it, I root for it's success and pine for it's attention. But today I am here for vengeance. Lumberjack, to long have you been allowed to swing your axe without a sap of remorse, to long have you been the root problem to all my frustrations. But no longer. Today you have barked up the wrong tree and now you will face justice.

10.name: Sour
10.text: Yeah. Can we not do this. We're kind of on an important quest here, so if you could move aside that would be great.

11.name: Choc'lat
11.text: Birch please. Do you know who your talking to. Do you know how long I've been waiting for this. Wooimabouttomakeanameformyselfhere.

12.name: Sour
12.text: If it's a fight you want it's a fight you'll get. I've been waiting for something to spruce this quest up.

13.name: Sweat
13.text: Not you to Sour. Look mister Choc'lat is there anyway you can let us pass without us having to fight you.

14.name: Choc'lat
14.text: There is one way. The lumberjack must throw down his axe and vow to never pick up another one.

15.name: Sweat
15.text: Is that it? Great, mortal throw down your axe and we'll be on our way.

16.name: Sour
16.text: No way. Don't listen to that loser. Your axe is like an extension of your arm, you shouldn't have to give it up just cause some sappy willow told you to.

18.name: Sweat
18.text: We don't have time for this. Don't be a meathead, just drop the axe.

fight_0.name: Lumberjack
fight_0.text: I wasn't planning on fighting but the thought grew on me.

fight_2.name: Sweat
fight_2.text: I'm dealing with a bunch of children.

fight_3.name: Sour
fight_3.text: Quick Choc'lat is about to attack get ready to defend yourself.

fight_4.name: Sour
fight_4.text: Make sure to defend against the correct type of attack that Choc'lat sends out.

fight_5.name: Narrator
fight_5.text: Use the 'wasd' and arrow keys to block Choc'lats attacks. Click on the icons at the top right to switch your defensive style.

drop_0.name: Narrator
drop_0.text: The lumberjack releases the axe from their hands.

drop_1.name: Lumberjack
drop_1.text: Oh great Choc'lat, guardian of the forest I hereby vow to never pick up or swing another axe again.

drop_2.name: Narrator
drop_2.text: A white light envelops the lumberjack.

drop_3.name: Choc'lat
drop_3.text: A wise decision lumberjack. You may pass.

drop_4.name: Narrator
drop_4.text: The tree blocking your path slowly moves out of your way.

drop_5.name: Sour
drop_5.text: I thought you had a spine lumberer.
